name: Mistral
summary: Open-weight frontier models with customization and deployment options.
description: Mistral’s homepage on 21 October 2026 said it offers frontier open-weight models you own and control, customized with Forge, deployed with Studio, on-prem, in your VPC, or on Mistral’s cloud. No dollar price was in that sentence.

pricing.label: Open source
pricing.note: Homepage says the models are open-weight. Cloud and Studio may be paid; those prices were not copied.
